missing_questions: Guard scope for non-lexical constructions (no proposal asks this). Does a construction count as 'present' when it rests on a derived form (tawallā used intransitively, Form V) or on a semantic frame (dhikr 'by the tongue')? These two kinds make up 110 of the 397 root-dossier placements that every critic used as gold (و ل ي B007 n=83, ذ ك ر B004 n=27). The heuristics detect 10 of 83 and 1 of 27 respectively (/private/tmp/claude-502/-Volumes-OZTURK--projects-prose-generation/9b253717-be1d-4238-a42b-f4b098b1d894/scratchpad/phase2/Z-completeness/z04_orthography_probe.txt). The strict/frame/echo question that B, C1, C2 and D ask the user does not cover this case.

Is an early source that is not among the dictionary's six (Majāz al-Qurʾān, 1,308 ayah-keyed glosses) allowed as construction-level evidence? Phase 1 §5 and A's planned early-citation file say yes. The binding rule says sense evidence comes only from the project's own dictionary.

Evaluation-only question about the 29:38 watch case: it describes zayyana as 'adorning/coating', but the dictionary's three ز ي ن branches (root_000660 B001 beauty free of blemish, B002 beautifying / making beauty visible, B003 the set of adornments) attest no coating sense. Under the dictionary principle a 'coating' activation would be memory-sourced and must be marked. Should the scorecard reward it only when it is marked? Separately, ص د د B012 (a woman's screen or veil, bare, Tahdhīb) sits in the ayah's own fa-ṣaddahum, and no proposal or critic mentions it. It must not become a pipeline rule.

Production budget ruling. The three critics' combined designs differ about 2×: one Opus call plus a chain map at about $0.75–0.95 per ayah (cost critic), a two-call F2 sequence at about $0.7–1.0 (K critic), and B's primary at about $1.2–2.1 ($1.75 corrected; dilution critic). Is the ~$1 aim a ceiling?
Tier 3: 24 long surahs, about 3,113 ayat, with no HFT and no v5, about half the Quran. Accept a thinner product, or approve Luna-HFT at about $71–143 and 27–37 h of wall time (cost critic c06)?

Is the configuration of the v9 29:38 pilot acceptable as a positive-control arm, and as a production candidate through the synchronous API rather than Batch? That pilot had an agentic Opus read the whole package (about 350k tokens including building, ≈$1.7 per ayah), and the user called it 'great / excellent analysis and prose' (v9/DESIGN.md findings log).
How many blind pairs will the user read per round? B asks for 8–10 pairs plus a whole S88, and the critics add replicates. Reading time, not dollars, is the binding limit on replicates.

Should branch_kind be audited or repaired before it becomes a hard check? Its accuracy has never been sampled, and the S1 dictionary audit found 11 of 157 definitions needing correction, all unrepaired.
For long surahs, is a pericope-then-surah hierarchy acceptable? It adds a selection point before the surah commentary. S2's uncapped ayah commentaries total about 1.6–1.8M tokens (cost critic c08).

v15 scene paths are answer-contaminated (e.g. 'film over the eye' under body.eye). Drop them from C1 and C2, or approve a blind Luna rebuild? The rebuild is about 193 jobs, roughly $4 list-equivalent (Inference from the cost critic's median of 29k in / 12.5k out per frames job).

Should the user's own v9 gap list join the frozen evaluation gold? It covers the night shelter بيت ↔ عشو B006 (43:36) ↔ mustabṣirīn, the Ād / ع د د echo roots, and the Fatiha road resonating from 29:38.
Is API access available now for a Batch plus cache smoke test? Every production cost figure depends on a Batch runner that has never been built, and the CLI showed no cross-call prefix reuse.

unconsidered_alternatives: An agentic pull arm: Opus with Read access to a full package, as in the v9 29:38 pilot the user praised (v9/DESIGN.md: 'Opus lane … reads the whole package', ≈$1.7 per ayah). Every proposal pushes compact supplies and rules out tool loops only because Batch is single-shot. The synchronous API can run tool loops in production at roughly twice the Batch price (Inference).

One session with staged supply, over multiple turns: (1) a permitted cold reading; (2) script supply of rare branches with phrases, joins and counts, asking what changes; (3) the slice of the chain map; (4) compose. The turn order puts QeQ after the latent reading, nothing crosses a records-to-prose handover, and no independent canonical reading reaches an integrator. That answers the K critic's objection to B and the dilution critic's objection to A. The cost is re-billed context per turn, cheap only with API cache reads (Inference).

Surah at once for short surahs: one Opus call writes every ayah commentary and the surah commentary, which gives progressive disclosure (NS4) and NS12 natively for surahs whose output fits 64K (CLI) or 128K (API), e.g. S100, S103, S88. Nobody costed or tested it.
v5 middle-layer prose (the 1:6 version holds nearly every North Star image) integrated with a permitted cold reading, as the cheapest Q3 test. It appears only as B's optional arm C.
Reuse the existing output of the v11 arm-S seed pass (S1, $1.64, which assembled the herd, waymarks, rain and soft-against-hard) as the first chain-map input, instead of new S1 windows.
Rebuild the scene inventory blind with Luna, instead of either dropping scene paths or keeping contaminated ones.
Use the HFT traces (216,787 word→branch→role steps) as a co-activation signal for branch affinity, split by surah because it is circular with the HFT evaluation set.

Co-citation in early entries (Mufradāt 8,056 and Tahdhīb 3,239 ayah references filed under branches) as a per-ayah, construction-scoped activation signal that satisfies the dictionary principle, and as independent gold for the guard. B uses quoted-ayah 3-grams only as a licence.

A form-aware guard (QAC measure and voice plus the governed preposition) instead of lexical partner matching, which misses the derived-form and semantic constructions behind most of the measured misses.

Q2 read as 'training data' for fine-tuning or distillation (e.g. a cross-encoder, or distilling Opus readings into cheaper discovery): not discussed by any proposal, and blocked locally with no torch.

user_answers_status.question: Q1: Is this the most we can do?
user_answers_status.gap: Everyone says no and lists unused script layers (branch_kind, definitional joins, loaded-word counts, parallels) plus integration. There is no measured gain over the v5 bar (no runs). The alternatives with the biggest possible effect are untested: agentic pull, staged single session, surah at once, a form-aware guard, the early-citation file.

user_answers_status.question: Q2a: Where does the model's pretraining knowledge suffice, so data need not be pushed?
user_answers_status.gap: D's class-level map stands (rare, collocation and never-activated branches need data). But its central lever, permission, is confounded with the ledger (z05). Its labels are in-sample (13 ayat from famous surahs). There is still no cold 29:38 run (planned in C1 V3 and D V1). Whether the model marks memory as asked is untested.

user_answers_status.question: Q2b: Are there enough labelled examples to train or tune a retriever or distance model?
user_answers_status.gap: For branch pairs: enough labels, and the learned metric is no better than Neo (C1; features are the bottleneck). Not done: training an ayah-level retriever on the 623k graded pairs, quantifying canonical label bias at scale, a cross-encoder (blocked, no torch), and a surprise-class gold beyond the HFT outliers (which are circular for relay layers).

user_answers_status.question: Q3: Could a step on top of v5 with more data processing work?
user_answers_status.gap: A's digest exists and holds the ingredients. But coalitions from rejected candidates survive only 25% (k2c). Tier 3 (half the Quran, no HFT) is untested. S1 and S5 are mis-sized for long surahs. The cheapest test, v5 middle-layer prose integrated as a reading, is only an optional arm in B.

user_answers_status.question: Q4: A significantly different, non-iterative method?
user_answers_status.gap: B offers parallel readings integrated once, with F1/F2 fallbacks and a real change of method (frozen scorecard, replicates, seeded blind ayat). Not considered: agentic pull, a staged single session, surah at once for short surahs. B's core hypothesis is untested, though an $8–12 pilot on existing readings is ready.

user_answers_status.question: Q5: A better distance, improving or replacing quran-slm's, or new distance methods, so script discovery and harvest can run before synthesis?
user_answers_status.gap: Typed lenses and the guard were built. The only ordering validated on independent data (C1) does not transfer to the surprise class (z01), and the typed paths are validated only in-sample (spider, ghishāwa). Still open: contrasts (0 of 62), zayyana ↔ eye film, the user's night-shelter shared-concept link (عشو absent from every 29:38 supply). Untested: cross-encoder, personalised PageRank, a blind scene rebuild, HFT co-activation, early-citation co-citation.
